name: immich
title: Immich
description: Your Immich photo library from the panel: a CLIP search ("a receipt", "sunset over the sea") as a grid of thumbnails, the newest uploads before you type, a detail pane with the EXIF, the place, the people and the albums, and the albums, the people and today's memories as palettes of their own. Enter opens the photo in Immich; copy the link or the picture, download the preview or the original, favourite it, add it to an album, Quick Look it.

store.tagline: Search your Immich photos by what is in them
features: A grid of thumbnails from Immich's CLIP search: type what is in the picture ("a receipt", "dog on the beach"); a file name (`DSC00500`, `IMG-2026…`) searches by name instead

The newest uploads before you type; `since:2025`, `before:2024-06`, `in:2023` and `in:Ataşehir` narrow by date and place; the dropdown limits to photos, videos, favourites or the archive; a More tile pages on
The detail pane (open by default): the preview large, when and where it was taken, the camera, lens and exposure, the size, the people on it and the albums it is in

`enter` opens the photo in Immich, `cmd+enter` copies its link, `cmd+shift+c` copies the picture itself, `cmd+s` downloads the preview and `cmd+shift+s` the original, `cmd+f` favourites, `cmd+shift+a` adds to an album (or a new one), `cmd+y` Quick Looks it
Albums as a list with their covers, counts and dates (a shared tag on the shared ones): Enter drills into the album's grid, where the search runs inside the album
People by face: Enter lists a person's photos; On this day lists today's memories, a row per year
The library's counts and size lead the Albums list when the key may read them
`pal://immich/search?q=…`, `pal://immich/album?name=…` and `pal://immich/person?name=…` open the grids from a script or a keybind
Thumbnails and previews are cached under the user cache directory (`~/Library/Caches/pal/immich`), bounded, so a second look fetches nothing

screenshots.caption: Nothing typed: the newest uploads, the pane open on the first
A CLIP search: what is in the picture, the place and date on every tile
What a photo can do: open, copy, download, favourite, add to an album, Quick Look
Albums: the cover, the count, the dates, the library's numbers on top
On this day: a row per year with the places
Without a URL or a key: one row that opens Settings
